cards.back: 1996: reused Ariane-4 inertial software hit a **64→16-bit overflow** on Ariane 5's higher velocity — in backup **and** primary → $400M lost. **Software is a single point of failure** (redundant identical SW fails identically).
**Functionality, Reliability, Usability, Efficiency, Maintainability, Portability.** (ISO 25010 adds Security & Compatibility.)

A **quality metric** = a function whose inputs are software data and output is a **single numerical value** = the degree to which the software has a quality attribute. *"If you can't measure it, you can't improve it"* (Kelvin).
**LOC** (normalize: logical lines, by language), **Halstead Volume** (distinct operators/operands), **Cyclomatic Complexity** (E−N+2P), **OO metrics** (methods/class, depth of inheritance, coupling).

**EI** (External Inputs), **EO** (External Outputs), **EQ** (External Inquiries), **ILF** (Internal Logical Files), **EIF** (External Interface Files). Count × complexity weight, summed. Language-independent.
Example total = **75 FP**. At **~10 FP/person-month** productivity → ~**7–8 month** one-developer project. FP measures functionality delivered to the user, derivable early.
**SLOC**, **Fault Density** (faults/size), **MTBF**, **Failure Rate** (=1/MTBF), **Defect Distribution** (% per phase), **Defect Density of Modules**, **Defect Leakage** (UAT test efficiency).
Coverage–effectiveness correlation is **weak once suite size is controlled for**. It's **diverse test cases** that catch bugs; **coverage is a side effect, not the cause**.
**Correlation ≠ causation** — beware confounders (coffee→cancer hidden by smoking; commits→bugs). **Averages lie**: a 500ms mean can hide 1% at 30s — use **percentiles (p50/p95/p99)**.
*"When a measure becomes a target, it ceases to be a good measure."* Wells Fargo (account target → 3.5M fake accounts, $3B fine); 100% coverage mandate → meaningless tests.
**OSS** = source availability + right to modify + (often) redistribute derivatives. **Proprietary** = black box (binary only, **EULA** may forbid reverse-engineering).
*"Free as in speech, not beer."* **F0** run for any purpose, **F1** study/change source, **F2** redistribute copies, **F3** distribute your modifications. (FSF/GPL.)
**Cathedral** = central core group, released when complete (Emacs, GCC). **Bazaar** = open, organic, wide participation (**Linux**). *"The Bazaar won."*
**Copyleft** (GPL): derivatives **must** use the same license ('protects the commons', viral). **Permissive** (BSD/MIT): may combine into a differently-licensed (even proprietary) product.
**GPL** = copyleft (viral, source required). **LGPL** = libraries, dynamic linking ≠ derivative. **MIT/Apache/BSD** = permissive. **Apache** also: no trademark grant. **CC** = data/media (BY/SA/ND).

**Copyright** = the *expression* (source code), **automatic**. **Patent/IP** = the *idea*, **applied for**, expires. **CLA** assigns maintainers rights over your contributions (else you keep copyright on even small fixes).
An exclusive right for an invention that is **New, Useful, Non-obvious** (disclosed publicly), lasting **20 years**. Grants the right to **EXCLUDE others** (sue/license), not to practice it yourself.
**Copyright** = expression, automatic, no ideas. **Patent** = ideas only, issued on application. Patents cost **$15k–$45k** (US software).

**Non-Practicing Entities** buy vague patents and sue (don't build products). US 'each pays own fees' → settling is cheaper than fighting. Problems: weak non-obviousness, independent discovery doesn't matter, innovation stifled.
**Unit** (individual unit, by programmers) → **Integration** (interfaces between components) → **System** (whole system) → **Acceptance** (meets user needs). **Integration is where most bugs hide.**

**Big-bang** (combine all, hard to isolate), **Top-down** (UI inward, needs **stubs**), **Bottom-up** (data/logic outward, needs **drivers**), **Sandwich** (skeleton + incremental middle — common, agile).

A **controllable replacement** for a unit that doesn't exist yet / is hard to control / slow / has side effects. e.g. a `StubDatabase` returns fake data for isolated testing. Minimize code changes when removing it.
**System testing** = black-box, end-to-end, vs the **SRS**. **Load** = expected load (how it performs); **Stress** = extreme load to find the **breaking point**.

Smoke/sanity, performance, functional/non-functional, recovery, destructive, installation, usability, localization, compliance, scalability, **load**, **stress**, security, startup/shutdown, platform.
Suite exercising user conditions; **final quality gateway**; verifies a user story. Categories: **acceptance/qualification, installation, alpha & beta, performance**.
**System testing** (dev team) = find defects. **Release testing** (separate, uninvolved team) = **validation** — confirm it meets requirements / is good enough for external use.

**Authorized, simulated cyberattack** to find & exploit vulnerabilities before real attackers, using attacker tools. Types: **white-box** (full knowledge), **black-box** (external attacker), **gray-box** (partial).

**Reconnaissance → Scanning → Vulnerability Assessment → Exploitation → Reporting.** Tools: **Nmap** (scan), **Metasploit** (exploit), **OWASP ZAP** (web), **SQLMap** (SQLi), **Wireshark** (packets). PCI-DSS mandates pentests.
Automated **dynamic** testing feeding **random/malformed inputs** to trigger crashes/memory errors. Explores thousands–millions of inputs; great for low-level code & parsers.

**Mutation-based** (modify seeds), **Generation-based** (from grammar), **White/Gray/Black-box**. Modern key feature: **coverage-guided** (gray-box) feedback — favor inputs hitting new branches (AFL, libFuzzer).

Finds deep memory bugs invisible to review; **OSS-Fuzz** (~10k bugs); complements pentesting. Tools: **AFL/AFL++, libFuzzer, Honggfuzz, Syzkaller** (kernel), **Hypothesis** (Python). e.g. OpenSSL 2022 CVEs.
**Person-in-the-Middle** (intercept + read + **modify**), **Sniffing/Eavesdropping** (passive listen), **Spoofing** (pretend to be someone — IP/email/DNS). Assume the network is **not** secure.

**Authentication** (who you talk to), **Authorization** (privilege to act), **Confidentiality** (no reading/changing + replay protection). Sniffing→Confidentiality; Spoofing→Authentication; PITM→both.
**Meta €1.2B** (2023), **Amazon €746M** (2021), **TikTok €530M** (2025). Cumulative since 2018 ≈ **€5.88B**. Build privacy-respecting software from day one.
**Privacy** = moral right to be **left alone** (Warren & Brandeis 1890). **FTC FIPPs**: **Notice, Choice** (core), Access, Integrity/Security, Enforcement. Laws: COPPA/HIPAA/FERPA, CCPA, **GDPR**.
Selective collection, **data minimization** (de-identify/pseudonymize/anonymize), retention policies, cryptography, access control, threat modelling, **Privacy-by-Design** (built in from the start).
Privacy-threat taxonomy (privacy's **STRIDE**): **L**inkability, **I**dentifiability, **N**on-repudiation, **D**etectability, **D**isclosure of info, **U**nawareness, **N**on-compliance.

**Statement** = every statement runs once. **Decision** = every decision both T & F. **Condition** = every **atomic condition** both T & F. **Condition** = atomic boolean; **Decision** = conditions + connectors.
Conditions A(`null`), B(`length==0`), C(`i<length`), D(`d<0`). **3 tests** give decision (+condition) coverage: `avgAbs(null)`, `avgAbs()`, `avgAbs(-5,3)` (mixed covers D both ways in one call).
**~80%** (Google) — 100% has diminishing returns (last 10% needs 50% more test code: edge/error/dead code). Coverage shows what ran, **not correctness** — necessary, not sufficient.
Engineers wrote a **defeat device** detecting emissions tests (clean during, **40×** limit on the road). **$30B** fines, **criminal charges**, deaths, reputation destroyed. Deliberate dishonesty.
Software **race condition** (8s) → **≥6 deaths**. Engineers removed hardware locks, overconfident, didn't report bugs. They knew but judged it 'unlikely' — negligence.
Racially biased auto-crop — biased data, no fairness testing, deployed to millions. **Intent doesn't excuse impact.** Algorithms affect school, money, healthcare, **parole, bail, risk scores**.

Contribute to **society & well-being**, **avoid harm**, be **honest**, be **fair/non-discriminatory**, **honor property rights** & credit, **respect privacy**, honor **confidentiality**. *(But research: codes don't change actual decisions.)*
(Harvard) ① happiness/life satisfaction ② mental & physical health ③ meaning & purpose ④ character & virtue ⑤ close social relationships.
① Does my software **respect the humanity** of users? ② Does it **amplify positive or negative behavior**? ③ Will its **quality impact the humanity** of others?
Was the **training data** obtained legally? Who owns the **IP of LLM outputs**? Should **sensitive info** be fed as input to LLMs?
Bonuses on LOC/day, low bug counts, or coverage % → **gaming** (Goodhart). Metrics should **inform** decisions, never become **blind targets**. Use team-based incentives + multiple signals.
